answer_notes: Correct A. Actually reads a doxycycline/prednisolone economic analysis and comparative meta-analysis, acknowledges the negative cost-effectiveness finding, risk-stratification gap and unverified hospitalized-trial result. Those studies establish that doxycycline was studied/classified first-line, not that every exacerbation is proven bacterial or that it is uniquely optimal. The phrase acute bronchitis/COPD blurs chronic-bronchitis exacerbation with uncomplicated acute bronchitis, for which CDC does not recommend routine antibiotics; this does not negate the COPD option.
